title: bupleurum odontites var. baldense
intro: Bupleurum odontites var. baldense, commonly known as Alpine hare's ear or Alpine hare's-ear, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in European folk medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relieve respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis, as well as its potential to reduce fever and alleviate digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Bupleurum odontites var. baldense include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
